title: Deterministic actor event loop with mailbox queueing

workspace.test_actor.py:
from actor import Actor

def test_actor():
    received = []
    a = Actor('worker', lambda m: received.append(m))
    a.send('job1')
    a.send('job2')
    while a.step():
        pass
    assert received == ['job1', 'job2']
